4050-6553-8207.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

2692-4247-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1170-3698-5131-7693--202.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn. You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3698-5131-7693--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Armor Wars.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.

1170-1636-7529-7875.description:
Cast Rampant Growth using Party Thrasher's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Studious First-Year.
When Studious First-Year enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7725.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Selfless Police Captain.
When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7640.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reputable Merchant.
When Reputable Merchant dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Reputable Merchant trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reputable Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Reputable Merchant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

129-184-4682.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
129-184-4682.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Kinnan triggers twice, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

957-2061-7487.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Zealous Lorecaster.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second extra turn

2539-3094-4359-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4359-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1183-4853-5139.description:
Activate Relic of Sauron by tapping it, adding {2}
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Relic of Sauron.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3490-4050-5870-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-5870-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

804-6568-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
804-6568-7009.description:
Activate Sakashima the Impostor using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Sakashima the Impostor. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3532-5078-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

3875-4772-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3875-4772-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner each trigger twice.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

1987-2239-3227-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2239-3227-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and Scrivener.
When Ardent Elementalist and Scrivener enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2239-3227-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2854-3518-4574-5243.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-3518-4574-5243.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

222-527-4785-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4785-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

4094-5702-5954-6664.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
4094-5702-5954-6664.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
4094-5702-5954-6664.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat from step 4.

56-2523-5075-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-2523-5075-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Ogre Slumlord and Ratadrabik of Urborg trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-2523-5075-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

222-527-647-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-647-5686.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3525-4289-6210.notablePrerequisites: Neerdiv does not have summoning sickness.
3525-4289-6210.description:
Activate Neerdiv by tapping it, adding {U}.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Neerdiv.
Repeat.

969-1069-1256-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
969-1069-1256-5499.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1170-2792-4124.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {G}{G}
1170-2792-4124.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Whip Silk by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Whale.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4374-5666-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
4374-5666-5870.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wight of the Reliquary

2178-2374-5627.easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2374-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2178-2374-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Maja triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1832-3490-4659-4703.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have a way to give Brallin lifelink.
1832-3490-4659-4703.description:
Give Brallin lifelink, if needed.
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
Brallin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

275-2707-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, causing you to put Time Warp on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

1107-1636-2519-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Llanowar Mentor does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
1107-1636-2519-4050.description:
Cast Rite of Harmony by paying {G}{W}, allowing you to draw a card whenever a creature enters the battlefield this turn.
Activate Llanowar Mentor by paying {G}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Llanowar Elves creature token.
The Llanowar Elves token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Rite of Harmony.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Rite of Harmony trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Llanowar Elves token, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1749-4437.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
1749-4437.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Celestial Convergence triggers.
In response to the trigger, activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from Celestial Convergence.
Resolve Celestial Convergence's ability, winning the game due to being the player with the highest life total.

708-2459-2500-4050.description:
Pay {2} to Mirage Mirror to have it become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, returning Rograkh to the command zone and adding one mana of any color.
When Rograkh enters the command zone, both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

224-872-907.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.
